bioAdditions: An Iowa GAR membership card names a 'Caleb A' Pringle, born 1839 in Pennsylvania, who was a private in Co. G, 52nd PA Infantry, enlisted 4 Nov 1861 and discharged 5 Nov 1864 at the end of his term. The card also says he 'formerly resided at Sanborn' in O'Brien Co. (S1). The FamilySearch tree for Caleb Atherton Pringle, son of Benjamin Pringle and Charity Gould, attaches this card. It places him in Salem Twp., Luzerne Co., in 1860 and again in 1870, then in Floyd Co., Iowa (1880), Clay Co., Iowa (1885) and Rolla, Missouri (1900, 1910). He died on 22 Apr 1919 and is buried in Rolla Cemetery (S2). The middle initial A, the 1839 Pennsylvania birth and the 52nd PA service match on both, so the soldier and the cousin are the same man.
